fields.name: source port
fields.description: port of the sending process, may be assumed to be the port to which a reply should be addressed. if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: port within the context of a particular internet destination address.

fields.name: length
fields.description: length in octets of this user datagram including this header and the data. minimum value is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: one's complement sum of a pseudo header from ip header, udp header, and data, padded with zero octets at the end (if necessary) to make a multiple of two octets).
constraints: value == (sum of pseudo header, udp header, and data) complement

packet: array types summary per structure type: [],
